title: 3 AL/BC patterns: Insert/Delete trigger defaults on master data and declined Confirm in OnValidate
summary: Three new articles guide developers to use triggers when writing or deleting master data and to properly abort validations when user confirmation is declined.
key_points: Record.Insert() and Delete() skip OnInsert and OnDelete by default; use Insert(true) and Delete(true) for master tables
Declined Confirm in OnValidate commits the new value; use Error to abort or restore xRec instead
Articles cite exceptions: temporary records, XMLports, data migration rebuilds, and cascade deletes within the owning table
Review skills updated with targeted checks and documented exclusions
All fixtures verified to compile and all BCApps citations re-opened at main
